title_en: A Story by the Great Wall
story_zh: 来自美国的年轻小伙子汤姆，第一次参观著名的长城。当时，他戴着眼镜，心情很幸福。他熟悉中国历史，知道长城经历了多个世纪。他的孙子将来也会来吗？汤姆想。他吃了咸的小吃，味道很香。原来，不同民族的经验可以分享呀！
story_pinyin: Lái zì Měiguó de niánqīng xiǎohuǒzi Tāngmǔ, dì yī cì cānguān zhùmíng de Chángchéng. Dāngshí, tā dàizhe yǎnjìng, xīnqíng hěn xìngfú. Tā shúxī Zhōngguó lìshǐ, zhīdào Chángchéng jīnglìle duō gè shìjì. Tā de sūnzi jiānglái yě huì lái ma? Tāngmǔ xiǎng. Tā chīle xián de xiǎochī, wèidào hěn xiāng. Yuánlái, bùtóng mínzú de jīngyàn kěyǐ fēnxiǎng ya!
story_en: Tom, a young man from the United States, visited the famous Great Wall for the first time. At that time, he wore glasses and was in a happy mood. He is familiar with Chinese history and knows the Great Wall has experienced many centuries. Will his grandson come in the future? Tom wondered. He ate a salty snack that tasted fragrant. Originally, experiences from different ethnic groups can be shared!
